info.title: AyadERP API — Extension Vente (Gap Backlog)
info.description: Companion spec to api-docsV1.json. Every path/schema here is either brand new or an EXTENSION of an existing schema (marked 'EXTENDS'/'NEW' in its description). Nothing listed under _meta.already_implemented in API-GAPS-pipeline-vente.json is redefined except where a field was added to it. Order of implementation: GAP-01 -> GAP-02 -> GAP-03 -> GAP-05 -> GAP-04/GAP-06 -> GAP-07.

ReferentielItemDto.description: Generic id/code/description lookup row used for simple reference tables.

ProspectionDetailDto.description: EXTENDS the existing ProspectionDetailDto — adds tempDescription/tempTel/tempEmail (dbo_ComProspection.TempDescription/TempTel/TempEMail). All other fields unchanged from api-docsV1.json.

tempDescription.description: NEW — raw lead name captured before a Prospect fiche exists (ComProspection.TempDescription). Frontend must display this as the title/name whenever prospectId is null.

ProspectionListItemDto.description: EXTENDS the existing ProspectionListItemDto — adds tempDescription so pre-prospection rows can render a name.

tempDescription.description: NEW — display fallback when prospectNom is null (pre-prospections)

ModifierProspectionRequest.description: PATCH body to edit prospection qualification fields — no such write path exists today beyond etape/archiver/transformer.

ProfilCategorieDto.description: dbo_ComProspectionProfileCategory, with nested profils — used to render the 'Profils' tab grouped exactly as Omran groups them

multiSelect.description: ComProspectionProfileCategory.MultiSelect — governs checkbox vs radio rendering per group

PieceIdentiteDto.description: Grouped CfgTier.AdmIdentityDocumentTypeId + IDNumber + IDDate + IDPlace + IDValidateDate + IDValidatePlace

CreerProspectRequest.description: EXTENDS the existing CreerProspectRequest with the Omran 'Général' tab fields that were missing.

lieuNaissance.description: NEW — was read-only on ProspectDetailDto, missing here

professionId.description: NEW — CfgTier.AdmProfessionId, replaces/complements the free-text 'profession' string

ModifierProspectRequest.description: EXTENDS the existing ModifierProspectRequest — same new fields as CreerProspectRequest.

lieuNaissance.description: NEW — was read-only on ProspectDetailDto, missing here

professionId.description: NEW — CfgTier.AdmProfessionId, replaces/complements the free-text 'profession' string

ProspectDetailDto.description: EXTENDS the existing ProspectDetailDto with the same new identity fields (read side).

ReglementProspectDto.description: dbo_StlSettlement filtered by TierId — feeds the prospect fiche's 'Règlements' tab

HistoriqueDto.description: dbo_StrHistory / dbo_AdmWebHistorics filtered by ObjectId — feeds the 'Historique' tab present on every Omran fiche (prospect, prospection, dossier)

ContactProspectDto.description: dbo_CfgTierContact row, joined to the linked CfgTier for display — feeds the prospect fiche's 'Contacts' tab

contactProspectId.description: id of the existing CfgTier record to link as a contact

DevisDto.description: dbo_StlQuote (+ StlQuoteItem/StlQuoteDocument) — the 'Offres' tab. Deliberately minimal for a first pass.
